details:
Q1. What specifically should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or script in this repo (for example: clarify, plan, implement, review, validate) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Repo documentation or setup experience
C. Overall reliability/performance, but I will name the exact failing behavior
D. Something else; I will describe the exact component and problem
Q2. What outcome do you want from this change?
Choices:
A. Fix a concrete bug; I will describe the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a new capability; I will describe the user-visible feature
C. Improve maintainability or code quality; I will name the file(s) and what is wrong now
D. Improve UX/content; I will describe the exact workflow step, message, or document to change
Q3. Where is the problem or requested change located?
Choices:
A. I will provide the exact file path(s) or workflow name(s) involved (RECOMMENDED)
B. I do not know the file, but I can name the command, job, workflow, or feature area
C. I only have a general idea and need the team to infer the location from a detailed problem description
Q4. How should success be judged?
Choices:
A. A specific observable result or acceptance criterion I will provide (RECOMMENDED)
B. Match an example output / comment / behavior I will provide
C. General improvement only, no precise acceptance criteria
